title: Listening practice
subtitle: A2 · Unit 11: Solve a practical problem politely

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Le formulaire est incomplet. Il manque une signature. Cochez la case obligatoire et appuyez sur le bouton de validation.
steps.question: What is missing from the form?
steps.explain: The recording says a signature is missing.

steps.fr: Je n'ai pas reçu le colis. Pourriez-vous vérifier le numéro de suivi ?
steps.question: What does the speaker ask the other person to check?
steps.explain: The request is to check the tracking number.

steps.fr: La fuite d'eau est près du robinet. Je voudrais un rendez-vous d'entretien cette semaine.
steps.question: What does the speaker want?
steps.explain: The speaker asks for a maintenance appointment this week.

steps.fr: Pourriez-vous m'envoyer une réponse écrite ? Je confirme le délai de traitement demain.
steps.question: When will the speaker confirm the processing time?
steps.explain: The recording says the processing time will be confirmed tomorrow.

steps.fr: Le service à la clientèle va traiter la demande. La page de confirmation donne le numéro.
steps.question: Where can the customer find the number?
steps.explain: The recording says the confirmation page gives the number.
